// Synthetic router for the contract tests (example project). Not real code.
import { router, memberProcedure, openProcedure, signedInProcedure } from '../../trpc.mjs';

export const invoicesRouter = router({
  list: memberProcedure.query(({ ctx }) => ctx.db.invoice.findMany()),
  get: memberProcedure
    .input(idInput)
    .query(({ ctx, input }) => ctx.db.invoice.find(input.id)),
  pay: memberProcedure.mutation(() => null),
  publicSummary: openProcedure.query(() => ({ ok: true })),
  me: signedInProcedure.query(({ ctx }) => ctx.user),
  // A nested router reuses a key name.
  admin: router({
    list: memberProcedure.query(() => []),
  }),
});
